instruction: Right-click the first slide, select 'Slide Properties,' go to the Background tab, and change its color to light blue (RGB approximately 173, 216, 230).

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)
